messages:
jen: launching alpha A/B for v4-int6 vs v4-base (fp16). route split 0.5% traffic each variant (A=int6, B=fp16). primary signals: structured-field concordance, answer-fidelity (exact-match on test harness), hallucination_rate, latency_p99. auto-fallback rules in config below.

omar: what's the motivation for int6 here? previous int4 had too much rank churn for rerank.

jen: int6 expected to be a middle ground: lower cost than fp16, better fidelity than int4. want to validate on production slices before wider promote.

lucas: add a special check for multi-hop QA slice (mh_qa_long) and a low-volume VIP pin for `beta-client` to keep them on fp16 until we greenlight.

jen: done — pinned beta-client to fp16 route. adding mh_qa_long to watch_slices.

jen: gate config (draft):
```
gate_id: ab-alpha-int6-2026-03
split: {"int6":0.005, "fp16":0.005}
watch_slices: ["mh_qa_long","short_qa","structured_forms"]
metrics:
  - name: hallucination_rate
    threshold: +0.8%  # absolute increase over baseline
    window_s: 300
    action: immediate_rollback_if_concordance_below_96%
  - name: answer_fidelity_exact
    threshold: -2%  # relative drop allowed
    window_s: 600
    action: rollback_after_2_runs
  - name: latency_p99
    threshold: +5%  # relative
    window_s: 300
    action: rollback_after_5m_if_persist
notify: ["#eng-ml","#eng-oncall"]
report_interval_s: 180
```

sophia: can gate-bot post diff samples when hallucination check trips? that's high signal for triage.

jen: yes — enabling `sample_diffs_on_trigger`.

gate-bot: ab-alpha-int6-2026-03: run started t=0. cohorts: mh_qa_long (n=80), short_qa (n=200), structured_forms (n=150). will report every 3m.

gate-bot: t+3m report: hallucination_rate delta = +0.45% (within limit), answer_fidelity_exact delta = -0.9% (ok), latency_p99 delta = +2.1% (ok). no triggers.

omar: good so far. bump mh_qa_long samples to 200 for next interval to reduce noise.

jen: increased mh_qa_long to 200 for next run.

gate-bot: t+7m report: hallucination_rate delta = +0.82% -> exceeds +0.8% threshold. concordance for structured_forms = 94.8% (<96%). triggering immediate rollback for int6 cohort and posting sample diffs.

jen: ack. auto-fallback applied; int6 traffic scaled to 0.0. collecting diffs. triage needed: where did hallucinations spike?

lucas: on first glance the spike is concentrated in multi-hop with long context; seems to be a miscalibrated bias in the answer head after quantization.

sophia: schedule 30m postmortem sync and open ticket for quant recalibration on answer head + re-run with forced softmax-temp adjust.

jen: created ticket (#ML-4521) and calendar invite. follow-ups: 1) investigate quant calibration pipeline for answer-head logits 2) run localized sim-run on mh_qa_long with n=2k offline 3) disable auto-promote for this branch until two consecutive clean smoke runs.

gate-bot: diffs posted to secure blob (link). examples: 5 diffs showing hallucinated entity insertion; sample ids included.

omar: also add a guard to the gating system: if rollback is triggered due to hallucination, block any auto-promote of quantized variants for 24h unless manually overridden.

jen: guard added. summary: A/B alpha int6 rolled back due to hallucination + concordance failure on structured_forms; VIP pinned, diffs captured, follow-ups assigned. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
